summary: L-4 cab set below the summit in the 1930s; still there in 1983, now listed as abandoned and gone; no source describes remains today.

facts.design: L-4 cab below the summit, fitted with an alidade
facts.status_note: Still there in 1983; listed as abandoned and gone.

visit.trail_note: Listed as a hike-in site. A climbing guide describes a 4WD route to about 9,800 feet on the south ridge, with the summit about 1.5 miles from the road.

notes_for_editor: The climbing guide's peak is matched to the lookout by elevation (10,865 ft) and the Gilmore location; no source names the lookout on that summit. The 1930s build is undated, so no build event is recorded. The 1983 date comes from one source. Searches found nothing on what remains at the site today.
